notes.title: Rat Racer: Drift Physics Update
notes.content:
Hi! Here is new drift mechanics - now when your rat will gives too much throttle and then releases the clutch, the wheels will lose their grip and they will drift until the rubber will not catch the grip again.
The wheels, of course, react to the different types of ground. 

(the basic gokart does not have manual clutch so it cannot drift, use Quadra cars)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/49db6741081772b525a742276ce0f3a93db0daca.png

The clutch basically disconnects the engine from the wheels so you can save a bit of horsepower and use it a half second later, for ex. after a corner.

If you are using an Xbox controller you can disable Steam Input - the controller will map to default mapping:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/fce1d1acaff5287e49c2abfd9032163ea7224dc2.png


If you have Steam Deck you can use this mapping from Aris:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/09823879ad5469d6468557e4fa71f5da4fc6aa00.png



To use these features you need to enable Beta version:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/6722ef415069b5498ab5c0334e1c18730187a27a.jpg





Enjoy!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/a13f2ea30717330e686bb1a233cf568adecaa91b.png

notes.title: Rat Racer: New Car!
notes.content:
Hi guys! After a long waiting here's a new car - Quadra :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/1ea39feb5f475b90970126b80f39034dddef06ff.png

It comes with several paint options and other tunings, it has also manual clutch so you can get some advantage by using it creatively (or just for small burnouts).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/fce1d1acaff5287e49c2abfd9032163ea7224dc2.png



Also:
- there is better positioned audio, it is now easier to locate your opponent by ear
- when your resolution is too low/high, press L to set full/half/quarter res
- M mutes the music
- Shift is clutch. Ctrl is handbrake 
- Alt+Enter turns full screen on/off

Let me know here if you spot any bugs or you have suggestions for new cars or parameters to edit

Happy drifting!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/a13f2ea30717330e686bb1a233cf568adecaa91b.png

notes.title: Rat Racer: Physics update
notes.content:
Hi Racers! Here is "look and feel" update, where we have:
- new character: Bun!
- both characters have now redesigned look and animated bodies
- redesigned car suspension, both car and driver are reacting now on inertial forces - accelerating, braking, side slipping etc.
- Ragdoll physics!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/d08ec9cf1b1d0b461ac510f33f83f0b2dab5a37c.jpg

Let me know if you find any bugs
Enjoy!
jacku



*to use these features you need to enable Beta. Both players should run the same version of Rat Racer.
*in multiplayer your oponnent does not have ragdoll yet
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/6722ef415069b5498ab5c0334e1c18730187a27a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/a13f2ea30717330e686bb1a233cf568adecaa91b.png

notes.title: Rat Racer: New Race Track!
notes.content:
Dear Supporters - after a long waiting, here is "Wooden":

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/236c28e2f9cfe3e120b3d88a2a0b8125c3f80198.jpg

While the previous tracks were flat, Wooden is the first one with varying road heights and inclination. Use the analog gamepad and handbrake to keep the car grip. Driving at high speeds on this track may be unpredictable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/6398fcd959a7f7ec34d5bc36c423abf0a2e5b958.jpg

In addition we have more types of grounds such as undergrowth, mud, oil - each with its own physical characteristics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/2be89c805fdf348c76c5099eed6c4835baa1056f.jpg

Also:
- AI has been rewritten from scratch and has now more ways to win, however the script is not finished so sometimes it can be more stupid than before - it will be gradually improved in subsequent updates.
- The rats are fluffier

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/87a9a824b4c15fc9be0f89915f3e78d93c84ba0f.jpg

Let me know if there are any errors so I can fix them and move on to the next features.

happy drifting!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/a13f2ea30717330e686bb1a233cf568adecaa91b.png

notes.title: Rat Racer: New Race Track!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!
After a long waiting - here is The Village - a new race track where you can test all new physics features:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/c84ec18440813d2646a67576833f1b157142e2fe.jpg
The track has different kinds of ground and a lot of items to destroy. You can also move the items to block your opponnent.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/b5cdd5e075eb8ff9466fb7952a5bd1a05111d8b4.jpg
It's also more detailed visually so the hardware requirements may be a bit higher. 

New physics

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/9ca25ece37ff21f611266003334aa653ac2cc992.jpg
based on your comments, the car is now reacting to different ground types - dirt, tarmac, sand - you can feel this during drive, also visuals like dust, dirt, microbumps are upgraded. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/0ec13b9a554a9f16c232986cc6186159eda5f5b6.jpg
The camera is more predictable in both 1 and 2 players modes and there is a better slomo effect and overall post processing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/77088811ab86273844d7427b53ffd535857f29f7.jpg
Also, introducing Snowid! One of the best 8bit-medieval-rave-scene artist! There is only one music track but it's massive. You can also learn a few Polish words here:)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/6f6e9bb147cd78762be51200d046b8cb565fc34d.jpg


Let me know what works for you and what doesn't so I'll think about it in the next updates.
Stay stronk!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/41fc69079c18e8a3c4be6c5f3dfb058d8d6018d3.png

notes.title: Rat Racer Update
notes.content:
Hi guys! Rat Racer supports now analog steer and throttle. And the camera focus more on you than the AI player.
If you like to enable these features you need to enable Beta on Steam: game/properties/betas. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/b6328acc620a861de7392fee90a155a2a21a42a0.jpg

Note that the game supports 2 gamepads so your third gamepad may not work until it will be visible in Windows as gamepad 1 or gamepad 2. Set it as Preferred Device in Windows USB Controller Settings

Let me know if everything works so then I can publish the game and focus on next features!

stay stronk!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/41fc69079c18e8a3c4be6c5f3dfb058d8d6018d3.png

notes.title: Rat Racer Early Access Release
notes.content:
Hi guys, Rat Racer is now available as Early Access! This version contains racetrack #1 with working physics and from now I'd like to develop it with your feedback. Let me know what works for you and what's not.

What we have in version 0229:
 "Old Station" racetrack with playable game modes "Player vs. Player" and "Player vs. Ai"
 Photo Tool - during Pause Menu your mouse works like camera focus - use it to compose your shot and press F12 to take a picture


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36410119/6672eeb158c6072de58bcdc7542e9766d55e4a4d.jpg

Current limitations are:
 controller support - while the game officially does not support controllers you can control most of the car functions using analog XBox pad - but only as a yellow player during race, not in the menu.


Protips:
 multiplayer - you can play with 2 players on the same keyboard, would be good to have a mechanical keyboard with anti ghosting to prevent many keys from blocking. If your keyboard is limited you can plug in second keyboard, numpad or Xbox gamepad for player 1.

 graphics - the game is quite good optimized - it is possible to get about 300 FPS on modern GeForces and AMD's - during Pause menu press fps:max to test how many frames your system can achieve. But it's not neccessary to push your machine to it's limits so you can use built-in limiter, set it to 60 FPS to play with low temperatures.

 for old systems there is special Low Detail mode, on Intel HD4000 it's good to play in lower resolution but in High Details

Known bugs:
sometimes your car may be respawned two times, some of the environment are not fully physic yet, volume slider may not work correctly, car color selection may not work, bullet time may looks weird. If the game cannot start try to run it in windowed mode and then maximize.


Have fun and drive slowly!
Jacku
